_notes: PLACEHOLDER CONTENT. Badge list, times, copy, art, and audio are stand-ins until the real event plan lands. Bump `version` whenever art or sounds are replaced so every phone refetches.

badges.name: Breakfast
badges.shortDesc: Fuel for a long day in Forks
badges.longDesc: Charlie would make eggs. Bella would make something better. Either way, you cannot survive five films on an empty stomach.
badges.instruction: Eat breakfast to claim this badge.

badges.name: Vampire Baseball
badges.shortDesc: The Cullens play ball in a thunderstorm
badges.longDesc: There is a reason they only play during a storm. Witness the single most important sporting event in the history of the Olympic Peninsula.
badges.instruction: Watch this scene to claim this badge.

badges.name: Twilight
badges.longDesc: Bella moves to Forks, meets a very pale boy in biology, and everything changes. The saga begins.
badges.instruction: Finish watching Twilight to claim this badge.

badges.name: Lunch
badges.longDesc: Sit at the table by the window and stare dramatically at nothing. Then eat. You have earned it.
badges.instruction: Eat lunch to claim this badge.

badges.name: Volterra
badges.shortDesc: Bella races the clock in Italy
badges.longDesc: A fountain, a red-cloaked festival, and a boy about to step into the sun. Run, Bella.
badges.instruction: Watch this scene to claim this badge.

badges.name: New Moon
badges.longDesc: Edward leaves, Jacob takes his shirt off, and the seasons literally spin past the window. You made it through.
badges.instruction: Finish watching New Moon to claim this badge.

badges.name: The Tent
badges.shortDesc: A very cold night on the mountain
badges.longDesc: Three people, one tent, one blizzard, and a conversation nobody wanted to have. Somebody is hotter than somebody else.
badges.instruction: Watch this scene to claim this badge.

badges.name: Eclipse
badges.longDesc: An army of newborns, a treaty tested, and a choice finally made. The middle of the saga is behind you.
badges.instruction: Finish watching Eclipse to claim this badge.

badges.name: The Wedding
badges.longDesc: Flowers hanging from every branch, a very nervous bride, and a groom who has waited a century. Try not to cry. You will fail.
badges.instruction: Watch this scene to claim this badge.

badges.name: Dinner
badges.longDesc: Something warm before the final stretch. The Cullens cooked Italian for Bella once; you can do at least as well.
badges.instruction: Eat dinner to claim this badge.

badges.name: Breaking Dawn – Part 1
badges.longDesc: A honeymoon, a headboard, and the strangest pregnancy in cinema. You have seen things that cannot be unseen.
badges.instruction: Finish watching Breaking Dawn – Part 1 to claim this badge.

badges.name: The Battle
badges.shortDesc: Everyone fights the Volturi in the snow
badges.longDesc: Heads roll. Fan favorites fall. The ground opens up. And then... well. You will see.
badges.instruction: Watch this scene to claim this badge.

badges.name: Late Night Snack
badges.longDesc: The final feeding of the day. Vampires do not need snacks. You are not a vampire. Yet.
badges.instruction: Eat a late night snack to claim this badge.

badges.name: Breaking Dawn – Part 2
badges.longDesc: The saga ends. Forever is only the beginning, and you were there for all of it.
badges.instruction: Finish watching Breaking Dawn – Part 2 to claim this badge.

badges.name: Forever
badges.longDesc: Five films. Roughly ten hours. You watched the whole saga in a single day and came out the other side. Nobody can take that from you.

badges.name: Human Food Connoisseur
badges.longDesc: You ate every meal like a human. Edward would be baffled. Jacob would be proud.

badges.name: Twihard
badges.longDesc: You caught every pivotal moment. You know the difference between a Cullen and a Volturi on sight. Welcome to the fandom.

badges.name: Immortal
badges.longDesc: Every film, every meal, every scene. You did not merely survive the marathon; you were transformed by it. Your eyes may be a little gold.

name.prompt: What name shall be recorded in the Forks High School visitor log?

explainer.title: Your Saga Awaits
body: Before you lies the entire Twilight Saga, all five films, back to back to back.
As you witness the iconic moments and eat like a human along the way, tap each badge to mark your progress.
explainer.quote: About three things I was absolutely positive.
explainer.disclaimer: All times are approximate-ish. This passport operates on the honor system. The Cullens trust their guests.

passport.certifySubtext: Complete your saga and download your certificate

certification.title: Leaving Forks
body: Your journey through the Twilight Saga is complete (or as complete as you could manage).
By certifying this passport, you shall receive an official document commemorating your devotion.
certification.footnote: You will be transported back to Austin, TX, where the sun unfortunately shines.

completionMessages.perfect: Perfect completion! You are truly immortal.
completionMessages.low: Every saga begins with a move to a rainy town.

badgeModal.honorSystemText: The Twilight Passport operates on the honor system. By claiming this badge, you solemnly swear you have witnessed this moment (or eaten this meal).

checklist.description: Made a mistake? Toggle badges on or off below. Secret badges unlock automatically when you complete their requirements.
